newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Electronics hits new year's high.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Electronics hits new year's high.

text.p: Shares in Hyundai Electronics, a chip producer of South Korea's Hyundai Group, recorded a new 1997 high of 53,100 won in early trading on Wednesday on hopes for improved global semiconductor business, brokers said.
Hyundai Electronics went limit up, gaining 3,900 won or 7.9 percent.
Brokers said investors pinned their hopes on a recovery in semiconductor business and believed earnings in Hyundai Electronics would benefit.
"The bull-run in Hyundai is also in line with strong buying interest shown in core blue chips today," said a LG Securities broker.
